"ub"), "-") %>% mutate(rrc = ifelse(is.na(n), "Insufficient\ndata", paste(round(as.numeric(lb), 2), "-", round(as.numeric(ub), 2)))) center_idf <- st_geometry(st_point(c(657000, 6862032))) st_crs(center_idf) <- 2154 p <- ggplot(dep_shp, aes(fill = rrc)) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("#EEBCA9", "#DD908A", "#CC656B", "#BB394C", "#963442", "#702F38", "#4A2A2E", "#242424", "grey80")) + geom_sf_inset(color = "transparent", alpha = .83) + coord_automap(inset = configure_inset( centre = center_idf, radius = 22, units = "km", scale = 3, translation = c(350, 200))) + annotate("segment", 1310000, y = 7000000, label = "Rank-rank slope:"), aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), hjust = 0, size = 3, fill = NA, label.color = NA) + geom_richtext(data = data.frame(x = 880000, y = 7160000, label = "Paris region"), aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), hjust = 0, size = 3, fill = NA, label.color = NA) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(st_bbox(dep_shp)[1], st_bbox(dep_shp)[3] + 400000)) + theme_void() + theme(text = element_text(size = text_size), legend.position = c(0.855,.5), legend.title = element_blank()) ggsave("../articles/kenedi_sirugue_2023/out/map.png", p, width = bwidth, height = bheight, dpi = 400) ``` ```{r} fig8 <- fread("../articles/kenedi_sirugue_2023/src/fig10_mobility_nat_rank.csv") pct_movers <- read.csv("../articles/kenedi_sirugue_2023/src/in_text_figures.csv") %>% filter(Label == "%movers all") %>% pull(Figure) p <- fig8 %>% mutate(mobility = ifelse(mobility == 1, "Movers", "Stayers")) %>% ggplot(aes(x = family_income_n_spatial_household_income_rank, y = child_rank, color = factor(mobility))) + geom_point(alpha = alpha_color) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, formula = y ~ poly(x, 3, raw = T)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, seq(20,100,20)), expand = c(0.01, .01)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(30, 80), breaks = seq(20,80,10), expand = c(0,0)) + scale_color_manual("Geographic:", values = alpha(mypal, alpha_color)) + labs(x = "Parent household income rank", y = "Child household income rank") + custom_theme() ggsave("../articles/kenedi_sirugue_2023/out/geomob.png", p, width = bwidth, height = bheight, dpi = 400) ```
